productName: AIA Assemble Critical Illness Insurance Plan

trends.whatProductOffers: Lets the client assemble the plan from compulsory and optional Covers, with total critical illness coverage set between 100% and a maximum of 2,500% of the Initial Sum Assured of the Life Cover.

keyFigures.label: Coverage range
keyFigures.value: 100% to a maximum of 2,500% of the Initial Sum Assured of the Life Cover in total

keyFigures.label: Optional Covers
keyFigures.value: Heart-related, Nervous System-related and Other Illnesses
keyFigures.condition: each with its own Initial Sum Assured

keyFigures.label: Exclusive Cover
keyFigures.value: provided automatically if all optional Covers are selected
keyFigures.condition: selection of Multiple Cancer Cover is not a prerequisite

exclusionsOrConditions: Cancer Cover is compulsory and cannot be removed.
Total coverage cannot exceed 2,500% of the Initial Sum Assured of the Life Cover.
The exclusive Cover requires all optional Covers to be selected.
Waiting periods, underwriting rules and payout percentages for each Cover are not stated in the extracted text.
